text: 78 real historic earthquakes now strike in their real years with measured magnitudes and death tolls, from Messina 1908 to Sulawesi 2018, plus 38 more real volcanic eruptions from Kikai and Cerro Blanco to Novarupta and Hunga Tonga
Real recorded weather: from 1940 on, the weather panel shows the actual recorded weather for that day and place, and live weather once the sim reaches today

World wonders rise on the map in their real years and stay: the pyramids (gleaming white at first), the Great Wall, the Colosseum, Angkor Wat, the Taj Mahal, the Eiffel Tower, Mount Rushmore, the Twin Towers and more
Historic journeys you can watch on their real routes: Columbus, the Mayflower, Lewis and Clark, Magellan, Marco Polo, Darwin, Lindbergh and more
Real elevation and sea depth for the whole planet, real rivers and lakes, 16 biome types, giant trees like redwoods and baobabs
Famous landmarks get built in their real years, from Stonehenge to Mount Rushmore and the Burj Khalifa; the Grand Canyon carves itself
Follow a species and get an alert when it goes extinct; cloud on/off button; tap anywhere for a card about that spot
Ideas board with voting, live chat, viewer count, phone alerts, badges, clips, music and streamer mode
